originalProposals.reason: Earth is the densest planet (true; ~5.51 g/cm³). G5-E-11 current facets are sun-at-center, asteroid/comet, and rocky/gas-giant/ice-giant — density is not admitted. G3-E-6:planets is guided sky observation, not composition. G8-M-3:mass is subatomic mass; G9-E-5 absolute is radiometric dating. TL/BIS pinakasiksik OK. Potential G5-E-11 after a planet-density/composition facet.

Wood/cork float because density < 1 g/cm³ due to air-filled spaces. No current density/buoyancy core facet. G7-M-3:spaces would swallow macroscopic wood pores as particle spacing. G3-E-2 wood is products from earth materials. TL/BIS OK. Potential new density/buoyancy facet.

Teaches measuring mass and water-displacement volume to get wood density. G5-M-1 admits mass+volume but the competency is defining matter as having mass and taking up space, not the density procedure. G5-M-5 needs cylinder/beaker and mL/L; G5-M-8 needs mg/g/kg/°C; G5-M-9 is whether air/water have mass (investigation swallow). TL/BIS OK. Potential G5-M-1 after a density=mass/volume facet.

Floating depends on density versus the liquid, not weight alone. No buoyancy core facet. G5-M-9 liquid+weight swallows into 'do liquids have mass?'. G7-M-4:liquid is particle-arrangement diagrams. TL/BIS OK. Potential density/buoyancy facet.

Objects float if density is lower than water and sink if higher. No density/buoyancy facet. G7-F-10:sink is heat convection. Water-keyword hits (G3-L-6, G6-L-7) are swallows. TL/BIS OK. Potential density/buoyancy facet.

Deposition (gas→solid; frost; reverse of sublimation) is sound. G6-M-1 lists only melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation and requires diagrams/flowcharts. G7-M-5 is particle/energy for solid↔liquid↔vapor, not skipping the liquid. G6-M-3:reversing matches 'reverse' but is why physical vs chemical changes reverse. G7-M-4 would swallow into state-diagrams. TL escarcha OK. Potential G6-M-1/G7-M-5 after a sublimation/deposition facet.

Soap/detergent as surfactants breaking grease into droplets water carries away. G6-M-4 needs solution/suspension/homogeneous/heterogeneous and does not currently match. G4-M-2:work is invention-impact swallow; G7-M-10:test matches only 'same way'. TL/BIS OK. Potential G6-M-4 after an emulsion/soap-mixture example.

School deworming killing gut worms is real (DepEd/DOH). G5-L-1 needs named digestive parts; G4-L-1 needs how a body system works. G6-M-4:uses 'medicin' would swallow a health card into mixtures. G4-M-2:school is invention-impact. TL purga OK. Potential G4-L-1/G5-L-1 after a parasites/deworming health facet.

Insulin lets sugar into cells that use it as fuel. G10-L-1 glucose/homeostasis and G10-L-2 insulin-feedback are not admitted ('sugar' ≠ glucose; no feedback/negative). G8-L-9 needs the word respiration. G3-L-3:grow and G10-L-6:cell are swallows. TL/BIS OK. Potential G10-L-2 after an insulin/glucose-uptake feedback example.

Type 2: insulin present, cells resist, blood sugar rises. G10-L-1 needs glucose/homeostasis/blood pressure, not 'sugar'. G10-L-2 needs negative/positive/feedback. G3-L-3:respond ('stop responding') is a living-things swallow. TL/BIS OK. Potential G10-L-1/L-2 after a diabetes/insulin-resistance example.

Type 1: pancreas makes almost no insulin, so injections are needed. G10-L-1/L-2 do not currently match (no glucose/homeostasis/feedback). G4-M-2:uses is invention swallow. TL/BIS OK. Potential G10-L-2 after an insulin-deficiency/feedback example.

Diamonds form deep under high heat and pressure (mantle, not crust). G8-E-2 is naming upper crustal layers from sources (continental/oceanic). G5-E-2 is schoolyard rock texture/color. G4-F-10:heat is sources/uses of heat energy. TL diamante / BIS diyamante OK. Potential G8-E-2/G9-E-7 after a mantle/mineral-formation facet.

WHO: children should keep eating during diarrhea. G3-L-6:food does not match ('eating' ≠ food). No health/nutrition recovery facet. G6-M-7:benefits matches 'recover' as mixture-separation benefits. TL pagtatae / BIS nagkalibang OK. Potential G3-L-6 after a food-during-illness example, or a new health facet.

O₂ as a covalent diatomic element is sound. G9-M-7 specifies water and CO₂ (shar = sharing, not 'covalently bonded'). G9-M-8 is naming covalent compounds, not elements. G8-M-4 needs fixed composition/proton number. G8-M-6:oxygen is names/symbols of the first 20 elements. G9-M-3:bond is valence electrons; G9-M-4:oxygen is six valence electrons. G9-M-9:molecul is ionic crystals vs covalent molecules. TL/BIS OK. Potential G9-M-7 after an O₂/diatomic example, or G8-M-4 after elemental molecular form.

Diethyl ether as R–O–R solvent/propellant is organic-chem trivia. G7-M-8:solvent does not teach solute vs solvent roles. G6-M-4:uses and G4-M-2:uses are mixture/invention swallows. G8-M-6:oxygen is periodic-table names. No G9 organic-functional-group facet. Translations keep English terms (OK at G9). Potential new G9 organic-ether facet.

Adobo scent spreading by diffusion is a real particle-motion example. G7-M-3 motion/spaces do not match. G7-M-2:molecules does not state the particle model ('all matter is made of tiny particles; each substance its own kind'). G5-L-2:nose is respiratory parts; G10-M-1 odor is a reaction indicator. TL/BIS OK. Potential G7-M-3 after a diffusion example facet.

Stirring mixes dye faster than diffusion alone. G7-M-10 solubility factors (heat/saturation/test) are not admitted; anchors mention stirring but no stirring/surface-area unit. G4-F-5 fast/slow is pushes and pulls. TL/BIS OK. Potential G7-M-10 after a stirring/mixing-rate facet.

Sharp vs flat teeth as the feeding role of an outer body part is an exact G3-L-4:feeding component (beak|mouth|teeth|tongue). Other G3-L-4 facets (legs/wings/fin-tail) do not match. G4-L-6 herbivore/carnivore words are absent. G3-M-7:sharp is materials-handling. TL ngipin/karne / BIS ngipon/unod OK (BIS nahibaloi is awkward but the meaning is intact).

evidence.quote: Sharp teeth mean it ate meat, while flat teeth mean it ground up plants.

originalProposals.reason: Non-avian dinosaurs died; birds are living dinosaur descendants (consensus). G10-L-5 needs fossil/biogeography/morphology keywords and is a sources activity. G9-L-7:extinct is current biodiversity threats. G5-L-6:birds is life cycles. G8-E-3:extinct is volcanoes. TL/BIS langgam=birds in Bisaya, OK. Potential G10-L-5 after a bird-dinosaur morphology/fossil facet.

Dinosaurs lasted >150 million years; non-avian extinction ~66 Ma is sound. G9-E-6 geologic time needs eon|era|period or history|time scale — the card never says Mesozoic. G4-E-7:million is the Sun's size. TL/BIS OK. Potential G9-E-6 after a Mesozoic/dinosaur-timing example.

Birds, crocodiles, and small animals survived the dinosaur extinction. G10-L-5 evidence-of-evolution is not admitted. G5-L-6:birds is life cycles. G9-E-5:relative is rock dating. TL/BIS OK. Potential G10-L-5 after a K-Pg survivor/fossil-morphology example.

Same feeding-teeth teaching as the sibling card: teeth type → meat vs plants is G3-L-4:feeding. Other G3-L-4 facets do not match. G4-L-6 still needs herbivor/carnivor. TL malapad/karne / BIS hait/patag OK.

evidence.quote: sharp teeth mean it ate meat, flat teeth mean it ground up plants.

originalProposals.reason: Vaccines train recognition of a germ; high coverage makes spread harder. No immune-system core facet. G6-L-8 living-interactions needs mutual/parasit/predat/compet/symbio. G9-L-5:disease is biodiversity buffering ecosystems, not immunization. G4-L-1 body systems not admitted. TL bakuna OK. Potential new vaccine/immunity facet.

White light splitting into colors is dispersion. G8-F-11 is guided reflection/refraction with mirrors, blocks, lenses, prisms — no prism/investigation match, and the activity filter would block it. G6-F-9:light is transverse vs longitudinal. G4-F-10:light is sources/uses of energy. G9-F-11:visible needs the word visible. TL/BIS OK. Potential G8-F-11 after a prism/dispersion facet.

Finer salt dissolves faster because of more surface in contact with water. G7-M-10 current units are temperature/solubility, saturation, and investigation-test — no particle-size/surface-area facet. G6-M-9:table matches 'table salt'. G7-M-11:salt is acid/base/salt with litmus. TL/BIS OK. Potential G7-M-10 after a surface-area/particle-size facet.

Dissolving sugar is a physical change because it is still sugar and still tastes sweet — the G6-M-3 identity idea — but G6-M-3 patterns need physical.*(substance|identity), new substance, revers|undo, or 'clue, not a rule'. G4-M-5:chemical and G9-L-3:chemical are swallows. TL/BIS pisikal OK. Potential G6-M-3 after an identity/'still the same substance' facet.

Oil fractions separate because they boil at different temperatures. G6-M-6 lists decant/winnow/scoop/pick/evaporate/filter/sieve/magnet — not distillation. G7-M-5:boil is particle/energy state change, not fractional separation. G6-M-7:separat is benefits of those listed techniques. TL/BIS OK. Potential G6-M-6 after a distillation/boiling-point facet.

Soap lathers better in distilled water because hard-water minerals interfere. G6-M-4 mixture types are not admitted. G7-M-8 solute/solvent words are absent. G5-E-4:mineral is soil from rocks. G4-F-1:hard is rigid vs soft objects. TL distiladong / BIS gahi nga tubig OK. Potential G6-M-4/G7-M-8 after a hard-water/solution example.

Diwata-1 (2016) was the first Philippine microsatellite (PHL-Microsat; launched 27 Apr 2016). G4-M-1 needs invent|develop|creat and a named scientist — 'designed and built' does not match. G4-M-2 needs everyday impact. G9-E-11 is telescope/probe research on celestial objects. G10-E-1:satellite is GPS/geodesy for plate displacement. TL/BIS OK. Potential G4-M-1 after invent/design wording, or G9-E-11 after a satellite-research facet.

DNA as a twisted-ladder double helix is sound. G9-L-1:focus-1 is 'double helix' (space); the card has hyphenated double-helix, so it is not admitted, and G9-L-1 is models/labeled diagrams. G9-L-2:DNA would swallow a shape-only card into trait transmission. G4-F-6:twist is force changing shape. TL/BIS double helix/hagdan OK. Potential G9-L-1 after hyphen/space pattern and a structure (not only model/diagram) facet.

Four DNA bases whose order spells the instructions is a sound teaching component of DNA's role as genetic material (G9-L-2:focus-1). Gene, chromosome, and inherit/trait facets do not match. G9-L-1 base-pair facet needs pair|adenine|thymine. G7-M-11:base is acid/base. TL letra/bases/tagubilin / BIS letra/panudlo OK.

evidence.quote: Just four "letters" called bases — A, T, C, and G — and the order they're arranged in spells out all the instructions.

originalProposals.reason: Double helix discovered in 1953 (Watson & Crick / Franklin) is year trivia, not structure, models, or trait transmission. G9-L-1 does not match (hyphen). G9-L-2:DNA would swallow the date into heredity. G9-M-9:structure is ionic vs covalent models. TL/BIS OK. Potential G9-L-1 after a history/model-context facet.

Don't stop a run early because you like the result — a real fair-test bias rule. G6-M-8 needs change-one/independent, dependent measure, or keep-same/control. G6-M-9 needs three trials/replication or accurate records. G6-F-3:fair/test is lever fair tests. G4-E-3/G5-F-2/G8-L-11 fair hits are other investigations. TL/BIS fair OK. Potential G6-M-8/M-9 after a complete-planned-time/don't-stop-early facet.

Don't drop animals or people to test falling; use objects. Safety, not G5-F-5 heavier-vs-lighter gravity or G5-F-6 gravity effects. G4-E-6:safe is weather-disturbance shelter. Investigation 'test' hits are activity swallows. TL/BIS OK. Potential G5-F-5/F-6 after a living-subject safety facet.

Breed differences in fur, ears, and size are variation, but G10-L-4:variation is a small-group evolution discussion and the word 'variation' is absent. G7-L-7:differ is sexual vs asexual offspring similarity. G5-L-4 classification is a table. G5-E-2:different is rock comparison. TL lahi / BIS kaliwat OK. Potential G10-L-4 after a within-species variation example that is not a discussion activity.

Dogs have more ear muscles than people, so they can lift/turn ears. G3-L-4 outer parts for move/gather-food has no ear facet (feeding is beak/mouth/teeth). G4-L-1 muscular needs muscle.*(move|contract) in that order. G3-F-7:ear is harmful loud sound. TL kalamnan / BIS kaunoran OK. Potential G3-L-4 after an ear/hearing-part facet, or G4-L-1 after dog/human muscle examples.

Dogs hear higher frequencies than people. G3-F-4 is how sound is made/transferred, not hearing range. G4-F-10 is sources/uses of sound energy. G3-F-7:ear/hearing is harm from loud sound. G6-F-9:sound is longitudinal waves. G3-M-7:sharp is handling sharp materials. TL pandinig / BIS pagdungog OK. Potential G3-F-4 after a hearing-range example.

Dogs can learn commands with training. G3-L-3 respond/grow/reproduce does not match. Not a current behavior/learning facet. G3-L-2:dog is living vs non-living examples. TL/BIS OK. Potential G3-L-3 after a respond-to-training example.

Canine gestation ~63 days/9 weeks is sound. G5-L-6 mammal life cycles needs mammal|calf|carabao|puppy and compares stages to birds/plants — pregnancy length alone is not admitted. G3-L-3:reproduce needs reproduc|offspring|babies|young. TL magbuntis / BIS magmabdos OK. Potential G5-L-6 after a puppy/gestation/mammal-pregnancy facet.

Dogs smell things people cannot. G3-L-4 has no smell/nose feeding facet. G10-M-1:smell is a chemical-reaction indicator. G5-F-10:strong is electromagnet observations. TL pang-amoy / BIS panimaho OK. Potential G3-L-4 after a sense/nose-for-food facet.
